'''Temba Bavuma''' (born 17 May 1990) is a South African [[cricket]]er who captains the national team.

In September, South Africa toured Sri Lanka for three ODIs and three T20Is; in the opening match sustained an injury to his right thumb while batting and retired hurt.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fractured thumb rules Bavuma out}}</ref>
